$comment: The model and effort a next-session package recommends, as data. project-status reads this table when it builds the session package; nothing about model choice is hardcoded in the engine. Each category is ONE line, and both shells ENFORCE that: a 'key' line that does not also carry its model and effort -- a reformatted file -- makes the package refuse rather than guess, so keep one object per line and keep double quotes and backslashes out of the values. Order is priority -- the first category whose 'match' regex (case-insensitive, POSIX ERE and .NET compatible: alternation and character classes only, no lookarounds, no \b) hits the CAPABILITY TEXT ALONE wins; the owning phase heading is deliberately not matched, because one domain word in a heading would drag every row under it into the same category. The LAST entry carries no 'match' and is the default. The names below are recommendations to the person starting the session, not claims about how this project was built: a project edits this file to name whatever tools it actually uses, and sync will then report it as locally modified and skip it rather than overwrite it.
